title: Systems thinking
learning_outcomes: Explain stocks and flows in the context of systems thinking.
Compare and distinguish feedback loops in the context of systems thinking.
Apply delays in the context of systems thinking.
Evaluate and justify decisions about intervention points in the context of systems thinking.

lessons.title: Stocks and flows
lessons.outcome: Explain stocks and flows in the context of systems thinking.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving stocks and flows; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to system diagram.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain stocks and flows from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of stocks and flows; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Feedback loops
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish feedback loops in the context of systems thinking.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving feedback loops; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to system diagram.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain feedback loops from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of feedback loops; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Delays
lessons.outcome: Apply delays in the context of systems thinking.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving delays; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to system diagram.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain delays from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of delays; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Intervention points
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about intervention points in the context of systems thinking.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving intervention points; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to system diagram.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain intervention points from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of intervention points; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of stocks and flows; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of feedback loops; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of delays; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of intervention points; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.
assessment.reviewer: Education, statistics or philosophy specialist as relevant.

safety.notes: Respect consent, privacy and applicable rules; source and subject review before publication.
